instructions_text:
To use this page:

- Fill in all veterinarian fields
- Click Save Veterinarian to add a record
- Tap a veterinarian in the list to update or delete it
- Use Copy Previous Veterinarian to reuse old information
- Use Clear Form to reset the page
- Use the top-right menu to switch language
